name: confirm-baseline
q: Which walkthrough screens are firm v1 scope, which are aspirational (e.g. Premium intelligence analytics), and which prototype details are placeholders (member counts, copy, pricing)?
why: Everything else assumes the prototype is the baseline. Settle what is actually decided before any other ticket.

name: build-vs-platform
q: Custom build vs. a community platform (Circle, Mighty Networks, Hivebrite, Bettermode, Discourse) vs. a headless hybrid?
why: Research first (AFK): can any platform deliver the directory filters, profile PDF, QR connect, research directory and the Premium feature set without heavy customisation? Then grill to decide.

name: commercial-model
q: What are the revenue lines and who pays — Premium (US$99 founding / US$149), Advertise, Partners, paid event or research-provider listings? How long is the founding-member window? What are the member targets at 6 and 12 months?
why: Also resolve the US$ pricing vs Australian launch cohort tension.

name: member-eligibility
q: Open signup or vetted/approved? Corporate-email verification? What is the final taxonomy for Market type and Job role? Can students, vendors or non-professionals join?
why: Drives auth, the domain model and the invite flow.

name: privacy-and-residency
q: What do the Privacy Act 1988 / APPs require for: 'Who viewed me' tracking, downloadable PDFs of other members' profiles, QR-based data exchange, member-uploaded documents, hosting location and breach notification?
why: Research the obligations (AFK), then decide the stance.

name: operating-model
q: Who runs the community day to day — admin roles, moderation, approving research providers / events / Premium requests, support inbox, content policy, hours per week?
why: Several workflows cannot be designed until the people and hours exist.

name: tech-stack-hosting
q: Stack, hosting region, environments, CI/CD, backups, cost ceiling?

name: identity-auth
q: Email+password as prototyped, or magic link? MFA? Password policy (the prototype's minimum 6 is too weak)? Account recovery? Handling organisation changes?

name: domain-model
q: Entities and relationships: Member, Organisation, Connection, ConnectionRequest, Message, MessageGroup, Channel, Post, Attachment, Event, ResearchProvider, Partner, PremiumSubscription, Alert, ProfileView. Ownership and visibility rules per entity?
why: Resolve with domain modelling in a fresh session.

name: connection-model
q: Request/accept/decline semantics, the QR in-person connect flow, what is connections-only (messaging? full profile? PDF download?), connection limits, blocking?

name: messaging-scope
q: Real-time vs polling, group messaging rules, attachments, read receipts, notifications, retention, export?

name: feed-and-channels-rules
q: Post types, attachment limits (prototype: 5 files, 25 MB each), who can create channels, pinning, featured video source, like/comment/share semantics, moderation hooks?

name: search-approach
q: Can the Members / Research / Events filter sets be served from the primary database at expected scale, or is a search service needed?
why: AFK research on a research/search-approach branch.

name: premium-entitlement
q: How does 'Request Premium access' become an active entitlement — Airwallex payment link then manual activation, or webhook? Renewal, lapse and grace period? Founding-rate lock logic? Refunds, invoices, GST?

name: who-viewed-me-rules
q: Consent model for profile-view tracking (opt-in? anonymised for free members?), retention, what Premium members see, what viewed members are told?

name: premium-page-scope
q: What does a Premium member home page actually contain and how is it edited (Featured Insight, publications, speaking & media, presence)? The walkthrough shows only the preview.
why: Resolve by iterating the #premium screen in the prototype and linking the commit.

name: profile-pdf-qr
q: PDF generation approach and template; which fields; does downloading another member's PDF need their consent; QR payload (URL vs vCard) and expiry?

name: research-curation
q: Who may add research providers, what is the approval workflow, categories and provider types, seed list beyond ACSI & RIAA, de-listing policy, any commercial listing tier?

name: events-workflow
q: Who may list events, approval, required fields, calendar export (ICS vs links), virtual/in-person tags, past-event handling, any paid listing?

name: partners-advertising
q: Partner tiers and what they get (page, home-rail slot, featured video?), ad inventory and placements for 'Advertise', pricing, approval, disclosure rules?

name: invite-import
q: Invite colleagues: email template, CSV/Excel schema, limits, consent and anti-spam, tracking who invited whom?

name: notifications-alerts
q: Alert types (connection request, message, channel reply, event reminder, Premium search alerts), channels (in-app, email), digest cadence, email provider?

name: moderation-admin
q: Admin console scope: member approval, content reports, provider/event/Premium approvals, partner management, announcements?

name: responsive-accessibility
q: The walkthrough is desktop-only. Mobile-web scope for v1, WCAG target, which screens get a mobile layout first?

name: analytics-success-metrics
q: What does 'working' mean at 30/90/180 days (joins, profile completion, connections, posts/week, Premium conversion), and what tooling measures it?

name: cold-start-seeding
q: Launch cohort, founding-member outreach, seed posts/events/providers, and whether demo content is removed or replaced?

name: legal-docs
q: Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Community Guidelines, Advertising/Partner T&Cs, Premium subscription terms.
why: Human checklist — legal review. Not an implementation step.

name: accounts-setup
q: Airwallex account and payment link, production domain/DNS, transactional email domain, video hosting account, analytics account.
why: Manual work that blocks later decisions. Not an implementation step.
